subject: Security review: Redwood x Starlight — lock in availability
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@starlight.ai>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Security review availability — Redwood + Starlight

Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time to coordinate a security review with your team. Redwood's security/compliance and solutions engineering teams are happy to run through our SOC 2 scope, data handling, network controls, and the mutual action plan. To get us moving, proposed 60–75 minute slots (PT):

- Tue, Aug 22: 10:00–11:15 or 13:00–14:15
- Wed, Aug 23: 09:30–10:45 or 15:00–16:15

Attendees from Redwood (tentative): Marcus Lin (AE), Sofia Ivanova (Security/SE), Priya Natarajan (Compliance). Please let me know which slot works best and who from Starlight will join (security, procurement, and an engineering attendee are ideal).

I've attached our SOC2 questionnaire to give your team something to scan ahead of the call. If you have any must-cover items, flag them and we'll slot them into the agenda.

Attachments: Redwood-SOC2-Questionnaire.pdf

Best,
Marcus
Marcus Lin | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

Marcus — thanks. Our security team can do a review but afternoons are better for us this week due to on-call rotations. We also need procurement on the line for any contractual clarifications. Proposed windows (PT):

- Tue, Aug 22: 13:00–14:15 (preferred)
- Thu, Aug 24: 10:00–11:15 (backup)

Looping in procurement (procurement@starlight.ai) and Jane Ellison (she'll pick up scheduling). I attached our internal security checklist for reference — it has a couple of network and retention items we'd like covered.

Attachments: starlight-security-reqs.xlsx

1) Introductions & scope (5 min) — Marcus
2) Security overview & SOC2 scope summary (10 min) — Priya

4) Controls deep-dive (retention, encryption, access controls) (20 min) — Sofia/Priya
5) Contract/procurement questions & next steps (10 min) — Marcus / Jane

Expected attendees:
- Redwood: Marcus Lin (AE), Sofia Ivanova (Security), Priya Natarajan (Compliance), Diego Fernandez (SE)
- Starlight: Tom Reynolds (Security), Jane Ellison (Procurement), +1 security engineer (Mike Lee)

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/987654321
